definitions.explanation: A physical or figurative wall that blocks progress or separates things. Used for trade barriers, language barriers, social obstacles, and literal walls or partitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{障壁|しょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{障壁|しょうへき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Tariffs have become a barrier to trade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新規|しんき}{参入|さんにゅう}→新規参入：17044_shinkisannyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げる→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧{障壁|しょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is necessary to remove barriers that prevent new entrants.

notes:
Compound of {障|しょう} (to obstruct) + {壁|へき} (wall). Used in both concrete and abstract senses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {障壁|しょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧ (to overcome a barrier)
- {障壁|しょうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧ (to remove a barrier)
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{障壁|しょうへき} (language barrier)
- ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{障壁|しょうへき} (trade barrier)
- ⟦{心理的|しんりてき}→心理的：05686_shinriteki⟧{障壁|しょうへき} (psychological barrier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (wall) is more colloquial and can also mean "barrier" figuratively. {障壁|しょうへき} is more formal and tends to appear in written or official contexts. ⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ (obstacle/impediment) is broader and includes non-wall-like hindrances.
